3070.summary: Euro Truck Simulator 2 is a vehicle simulation game and a direct sequel to the 2008 game Euro Truck Simulator. Travel across Europe as king of the road, a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! With dozens of cities to explore from the UK, Belgium, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, and many more, your endurance, skill and speed will all be pushed to their limits. If you’ve got what it takes to be part of an elite trucking force, get behind the wheel and prove it!
3070.storyline: Travel across Europe as king of the road, a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! With dozens of cities to explore from the UK, Belgium, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, and many more, your endurance, skill and speed will all be pushed to their limits.

17470.summary: The ABC Murders is an adventure and investigation game adapted from the classic Agatha Christie novel. You are the famous private detective Hercule Poirot and, once again, you find yourself up against a mysterious serial killer who goes by the name of "ABC".
17470.storyline: Agatha Christie: The ABC Murders is a point-and-click detective adventure that casts players as the legendary Belgian sleuth Hercule Poirot. Adapting Christie's classic novel, the story begins when Poirot receives taunting letters signed "ABC," each foretelling a murder in a town whose name matches the killer's alphabetical pattern. As the bodies mount, Poirot travels across England to examine crime scenes, interrogate suspects, and piece together clues left in the wake of a cunning and methodical killer. Players must exercise the detective's famous powers of observation and deduction to unmask the culprit before the deadly sequence can continue.

27070.summary: Omen of Sorrow is a classic 2D, four-button fighting game, with Unreal Engine 4 powered graphics, a cast of 12 characters inspired by classical horror, fantasy and mythology, and a battle system designed from the ground up to leverage player skill, rather than stats or random chance, featuring deep combat mechanics that favor movement and spacing over tight execution to provide an engaging experience for pros and newcomers alike!
27070.storyline: In a hidden underworld ruled by creatures of the night, a new terror has awakened! Omen of Sorrow brings monsters of horror, literature and mythology together for a fighting game experience unlike any other. Inspired by numerous arcade classics but offering its own unique innovations and mature aesthetics, Omen of Sorrow positively bleeds style!

27270.summary: PAYDAY 3 is a 1-to-4 player co-op FPS and the ultimate heist fantasy, set in the most iconic city in the world. Gone without a trace or through a hail of bullets. Either way, you're getting out with the prize.

87770.summary:
Sable's Grimoire is a visual novel / dating sim featuring monster girls in a magic academy setting.

Play as Sable, an aspiring magic researcher, as he get sucked into the daily lives and troubles of his demi-human classmates.

109970.summary: Endless Dungeon is a Rogue-lite Tactical Action game, set in the award-winning Endless universe. Recruit a team of shipwrecked heroes, plunge into a long-abandoned space station, and protect your crystal against never-ending waves of monsters… or die trying, get reloaded, and try again.
109970.storyline: Well, your ship is dead as a doornail and you're stuck on some spatial station that went to the dogs back before they knew how to bark. There's some folks been marooned here for decades, full of tall tales about what is and isn't; stories about how you might get out – or how you might be stuck here pretty much forever… It’s all on you to figure out what’s happenin’, team up with some other castaways, and survive a brand spanking new story in the Endless universe.

111370.summary: No Time to Relax is a life simulation game where up to 4 players online or locally compete against each other in the ultimate game of life.

117170.summary: Stellar Blade is a third-person action-adventure game set on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Players control Eve, an elite soldier deployed from an orbital colony to reclaim the planet from hostile creatures called Naytibas. The combat system emphasizes timing-based parrying and evasion, with skill gauges that unlock powerful attacks and buffs. The game features exploration across ruined environments, side quests from NPC survivors in the last human city of Xion, and a narrative with multiple endings based on player choices.
117170.storyline: At the start of the 22nd century, the AI known as Mother Sphere was created to advance humanity, but the arrival of monstrous creatures called Naytibas drove humans from Earth. From their orbital sanctuary, the Colony sends elite soldiers to reclaim the planet. Eve, a soldier from the 7th Airborne Squad, is the sole survivor of a failed operation. Rescued by Adam, a scavenger who remained on Earth, she reaches Xion, humanity's last city. As Eve hunts Alpha Naytibas to locate the Elder Naytiba, she uncovers a disturbing truth: the "humans" from the Colony are synthetic beings called Andro-Eidos, created by Mother Sphere to replace the original humans, and the Naytibas are what real humans became in their attempts to evolve and fight back. Eve must decide whose side she is on as she confronts Adam's true identity and a choice that will determine humanity's future.

119270.summary:
On the planet Dahna, reverence has always been given to Rena--the planet in the sky--as a land of the righteous and divine. Stories handed down for generations became truth and masked reality for the people of Dahna. For 300 years, Rena has ruled over Dahna, pillaging the planet of its resources and stripping people of their dignity and freedom.

Our tale begins with two people, born on different worlds, each looking to change their fate and create a new future. Featuring a diverse cast of characters, intuitive and rewarding combat system, and a captivating story set in a lush world worth fighting for, Tales of Arise delivers a first-class JRPG experience.
119270.storyline: On the planet Dahna, reverence has always been given to Rena, the planet in the sky, as a land of the righteous and divine. Stories handed down for generations became truth and masked reality for the people of Dahna. For 300 years, Rena has ruled over Dahna, pillaging the planet of its resources and stripping people of their dignity and freedom.

120170.summary:
Discover the shattered world of Solasta: explore ruins and dungeons for legendary treasures, learn the truth of an age-old cataclysm - and stop it from happening again.

Create your very own party of adventurers with our Character Creation Tool in the classic tabletop RPG tradition. Breathe life into your heroes, and see their personalities reflected in their dialogue. Tailor your squad to your preferred strategy and maximize your party's abilities. The choice is yours.

Delve into long forgotten dungeons to unearth ancient artifacts, but stay watchful of light and darkness: many dangers hide in the dark, but a light can attract monsters. Some enemies have darkvision, some may flee from your torch... Successful adventurers will learn to use it to their advantage.

Fight monsters in squad-level, turn-based, tactical combat. Solasta's dynamic environment offers some interesting tactical options. Bridges can collapse, leaving enemies stranded and vulnerable. Walls and columns can be pushed over - on top of your foes, if you do it right. The world is your playground.

121970.summary: "Dark reflection" is a mix of good old-fashioned aesthetics of pixel games, black humor and light philosophy with cool and catchy music.

122270.summary:
In Hourglass you can create a time-clone of yourself to solve challenging puzzles. You will play as Aywa, a young adventurer who is traveling to Egypt to find her missing father - an archeologist, who never returned from his latest expedition.

Pyramids are the tombs of the pharaohs. This is what most people believe. But more and more studies raise doubts about this thesis. Scientists found indications for ancient egypt being far more technologized than we can imagine. Hourglass is set in a scenario in which those assumptions are actually true..

Besides offering an ancient world to explore, Hourglass is mostly about solving various puzzles with a unique core-mechanic. Your ability allows you to record your actings for a certain amount of time. After that, time winds back to the beginning of the recording and a time-clone of yourself appears, repeating the actions.
122270.storyline:
"Pyramids are the tombs of the pharaohs". This is what most people believe. But more and more studies raise doubts about this thesis. Scientists found indications for ancient Egypt being far more technologized than we can imagine. Hourglass is set in a scenario in which those assumptions are actually true..

You will play as Aywa, a young adventurer who is travelling to Egypt to find her missing father - an archaeologist, who never returned from his latest expedition.

Your journey leads you to a remote temple where you encounter undiscovered Egyptian technologies and portals to a foreign world.

Only by unraveling the secrets of these long lost technologies, you are able to solve all puzzles on your quest and eventually find your father.

126470.summary:
The 3rd game in the "one night , hot springs" series of visual novels

manami is talking to her boyfriend tatsuya, when he asks her why she didn't tell him that her two friends were dating. manami thinks he just has the wrong idea, but...

Spring Leaves No Flowers is a visual novel. play as manami, a young woman with a boyfriend named tatsuya, and join her as she spends the weekend with her friends. help manami come to an understanding about herself as she thinks about what friendship and romance mean to her.

127770.summary: An arcade racer that tears up the rule book with innovative twin-stick controls, completely re-imagined driving mechanics and a huge roster of fiercely individual cars and tracks.

134070.summary: Re-made from the ground up, rise through the ranks of the Mafia during the Prohibition era of organized crime. After a run-in with the mob, cab driver Tommy Angelo is thrust into a deadly underworld. Initially uneasy about falling in with the Salieri crime family, Tommy soon finds that the rewards are too big to ignore.
134070.storyline:
The city of Lost Heaven got hit hard by The Great Depression, and the advent of Prohibition in America means lucrative business opportunities for mobsters. The Salieri and Morello crime families vie for control over Lost Heaven, even as its few honest policemen scramble to maintain order.

Thomas Angelo's humble life as a hard-working taxi driver is forever changed after a fateful run-in with the Italian Mafia.

135670.summary: Paris, 1789. The French Revolution has been suppressed with bloodshed by Louis XVI and his merciless mechanical army. Aegis, a mysterious automaton masterpiece, must confront the king's army alone to save history in this challenging action-RPG.

137070.summary: Terraformers is a 3X game with roguelite elements in which you terraform Mars. Explore the planet's wonders, exploit its resources and expand by settling new cities. Start the terraforming process: warming the planet, creating oceans and spreading life!

140870.summary:
Motesolo: No Girlfriend Since Birth
Interactive Movie.
On a late afternoon in Seoul, There are two people having a blind date in cafe.
But this man is so suspicious. He acts like the man who doesn't have any girl friend.
Unfortunately this is true. yes. He is NGSB. No GirlFriend Since Birth.

He is 29 years old and There is saying that the virgin in 30 will finally become a black magician .
There are only bunch of boys in his life like men's middle school, men's high school, major in computer in Univ and military..
This is last chance to have a girl friend before turning into 30 in this blind date.
His life depends on your choices.
140870.storyline:
Motesolo : No Girlfriend Since Birth
On a late afternoon in Seoul, There are two people having a blind date in cafe.
But this man is so suspicious. He acts like the man who doesn't have any girl friend.
Unfortunately this is true. yes. He is NGSB. No GirlFriend Since Birth.

He is 29 years old and There is saying that the virgin in 30 will finally become a black magician .
There are only bunch of boys in his life like men's middle school, men's high school, major in computer in Univ and military..
This is last chance to have a girl friend before turning into 30 in this blind date.
His life depends on your choices.

143470.summary: Cooperatively build a path to guide spirits home!
143470.storyline: Catty & Batty are getting ready for their latest adventure, when *suddenly* eight spirits appear around Catty! They choose to help them find their way home.

145070.summary: Despelote is a soccer game about people. Get immersed in the streets and parks of Quito through the eyes and ears of eight year old Julián. Dribble, pass and shoot your soccer ball around town, and see what happens when you kick it someone's way. Feel the city change as Ecuador comes closer than ever to qualifying for the World Cup.
145070.storyline: The game consists of three “days,” with each one taking place at a different phase in the player’s life. As you get older, so do the characters in the world around you. Your interactions with them, as well as your relationship to soccer itself, change dramatically with time.

149870.summary: Service off-road vehicles and take them for a drive! Offroad Mechanic Simulator lets you modify many classic off-road vehicles and prepare them for daunting tasks that no normal car could ever hope to complete. Test your work and climb steep cliffs or drive through rivers and deep layers of mud.

157970.summary: Katy, a French sniper, needs to protect her magnificent city! A 2D sniper game like you've never seen! In this spin-off of the Geometric Sniper the missions are more and more challenging, you will not have a second chance. Accuracy is everything!

167270.summary: In this puzzle platformer, you will embark on a touching journey through the surreal world of a person's mind as a young Griffin and his faithful bear, Birly. Overcome challenges, avoid traps and defeat enemies to help the man find peace.
167270.storyline:
Daydream - puzzle-platformer adventure game. Go through the trials in the fantasy world, controlling the hero and his teddy bear.
Get the unique experience of passing the game by two characters.

The mechanics of the game is simple - the player is playing for the hero in three-dimensional plane. Character control is tactile. The set of actions that he is able to perform is small: climb, jump, grab and use objects, as well as interact with secondary, but no less important characters.

Also the player can give instructions to his partners - wherefore the gameplay becomes even more pleasant, because it is always more fun to spend time with a friend.

188470.summary: The cute fantasy visual novel, "How to Fool a Liar King" returns as a remastered version. Regina, a girl who loves cats, a bit forgetful but confident in her strength, suddenly appears inside a forest in Eroolia. Juli immediately finds her, but how did she get here?

198070.summary:
Jim's Adventure is a game where you need to follow Jim, the Native American in an exciting and challenging adventure. He is exploring a large world filled with perils, ranging from various creatures to obstacles, all trying to stop him. There are a multitude of levels to complete and Jim has a very limited amount of lives.

Every level has its fair share of challenges, and there are multiple game worlds ranging from haunted forests to deserts, caves and many others.

202770.summary: Ten is a challenging platformer in which you face a relentless gauntlet of ten-second deathtrap rooms in a desperate struggle to escape your fate and uncover the truth!

204370.summary:
Diggergun is an oppressive, 2D, platformer about workers, low wages and the environment.

Will you band together with others to push back against your corporate oppressors, side with your employer to get a leg up or just escape at the first opportunity possible?
204370.storyline: After arriving on an island off the coast of Cornwall to work as Engineer, you’re quickly put to work in the lithium mines due to the flexibility clause in your contract. With the Cornwall Mining Corporation demanding a £3,000 fee to terminate your employment contract and take you back to the mainland, you’re left with nothing to do but dig.

208570.summary: Particle Hearts is a 3rd-person adventure game where you explore a world made entirely of particles. Use special abilities to manipulate those particles, solve puzzles, avoid detection, and navigate this sinister and beautiful land.
208570.storyline:
Explore a world made entirely of particles. Use special abilities to manipulate those particles, solve puzzles, avoid detection, and uncover the role you play in this sinister and beautiful land.

Along the way, meet various creatures, some of which will help you understand your purpose and others who are tasked with hiding it from you.

Collect memories, find hidden paths, and piece together your connection to this land that isn’t always what it seems.

210670.summary: As every summer holidays Bump went to the family farm but got lost on the way. Help Bump find the right way back to farm and maybe he won't be late for dinner.

211470.summary: Blight: Survival is an upcoming medieval, co-operative, action horror game set in an alternate 14th century powered by Unreal Engine 5.

211670.summary: Rivalia is a singleplayer ARPG and Roguelite video game, with a cartoon art style that combines the best of both genres. In it, you will take control of 4 main characters who must confront the evil jester who has wrapped the castle of Rivalia in a space-time loop.

219170.summary: This year you have been assigned to be the CEO of the Pumpkin farm. Start growing the pumpkin and become the biggest pumpkin farm in the world.

223270.summary: Dead of Darkness is a 2D survival-horror action-adventure. Investigate a missing persons case on Velvet Island and unravel its disturbing secret. You’ll have to face grotesque creatures, hurdle deadly traps, solve puzzles, and most importantly, survive.
223270.storyline: England, 1985. Private investigator Miles Windham is asked to help the local police on a missing persons investigation on Velvet Island. But once he arrives on the island, he soon realizes that the residents are behaving strangely. Nobody seems to be interested in clearing up the case. In fact, there is a growing hostility towards the investigator that feels as though it is becoming stronger by the minute. It doesn't take long until the situation escalates and Miles finds himself in a struggle for his own survival.

225770.summary: This is an enhanced version of the original Raiden III, which came out in 2005 for arcades and consoles. There will be some new game modes, online features, and customization options.

233970.summary: Sulfur is a modern old-school action-adventure: Outsmart enemies, find treasure, improve weapons, harness powers. Delve deeper, find answers, make it end.

239370.summary: Unleash your creativity with Linkito! Connect blocks to solve unique puzzles and create your own masterpieces. A sandbox puzzle game with endless possibilities. Join the Linkito community and share your puzzles with the world.

248270.summary:
Beavers are interesting creatures, they are both wet and furry, due to being in the water so much. Many of us have never stroked one before, but now if your chance to touch one for the first time.

Well, you can't really touch one, but you can at least make it look like you have a beaver in your very own home.

252870.summary: Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

259170.summary: In the "Forbidden Trial", a Roguelike role-playing action game, you will play a girl Einherjar in the Spirit Hall of Norse mythology, and find the truth of the gods at dusk through fighting and exploration.

267770.summary: Go around the circle dodge the bullets and collect diamonds to increase your score!

268370.summary:
Embark on an extraordinary adventure and help a living world.

Paper Beast Enhanced Edition Improvements:
- Smooth locomotion.
- HDR image fine-tuned specifically for PS VR2, for vibrant colors and smooth nuances.
- 4K rendering.
- Detailed textures and high-resolution shadows.
- Light shaft effects.
- Extremely precise sand and water physics.
- Sandbox: The terrain is more expansive, with an increased number of creatures and trees that become even more stunning over time.
- Option of playing without a VR headset.
268370.storyline: Somewhere deep down in the vast memory of a data server, an ecosystem has emerged. Decades of lost code and forgotten algorithms have accumulated in the eddies and flows of the internet. A small bubble of life has blossomed. Paper Beast is born.

278670.summary: "Incantation" is a first-person horror mystery game adapted from a movie of the same name. The game reveals the chilling story behind "Chen Village" from the movie. A mother searching for her missing daughter accidentally stumbles into a village filled with mysterious cults. Beyond the palpable madness and fear in the village, there's a sinister force that drives one to despair. What happens when one crosses the forbidden line of this evil deity?
278670.storyline: A mother, searching for her lost daughter, stumbles into a strange cult village. "Incantation" is a first-person horror game. It reveals the chilling story behind the cult village "Chen Family Village". What are the consequences of crossing dark boundaries?

280670.summary: Timo Boll Beats is a unique rhythm game that takes place in the thrilling world of table tennis! In this game, you will have the opportunity to hit the ball like Timo Boll to the rhythm of the music, immersing yourself in a fun and thrilling experience like never before.

285170.summary: On Rock Canvas, you are the artist! With the help of a variety of tools, create sculptures for Rocky's cave. But be careful, Rocky is a little demanding with his sculptures, he will tell you what tool to use for his next great masterpiece!

294270.summary: Face the challenge of being a real, fragile egg. Climb out of the hen house and survive in a shop, a kitchen, and other dangerous areas. Roll, jump, and use the environment to reach new heights. Don't break your eggshell, and do your best not to fall. With determination, you may reach freedom!

294870.summary:
SaGa Frontier 2 Remastered is a nonlinear RPG focused on exploration, political intrigue, and character-driven storytelling. Players guide a mysterious protagonist through rival city-states and supernatural threats, using strategic turn-based combat, customizable party development, and branching narratives that shift with player choices.
The remaster sharpens the original’s impressionist watercolor visuals to higher resolution, rebuilds the UI for smoother play, and adds new events and playable characters that expand Sandail’s stories. New systems include Parameter Inheritance for deeper stat customization, enhanced boss encounters for tougher challenges, recruitable diggers who can return with expedition loot, plus quality-of-life additions like high-speed modes and New Game+.
294870.storyline:
Our tale starts with two protagonists: Gustave, heir to an esteemed royal line, and Wil, a young man who makes his way in the world performing excavation work.
Though born in the same era, their circumstances could not be more different, and as Gustave is faced with strife and conflict between nations, Wil finds himself confronting a world-threatening calamity that lurks in the shadows.
Their stories gradually coalesce to form a single history.

295570.summary: You are trapped on a train that runs forever. Keep an eye out for anomalies and find a way out.
295570.storyline:
You are trapped on a train that runs forever.
Keep an eye out for anomalies and find a way out.

Please be aware of any train anomalies..

302070.summary: Beaked Buccaneer is a 2D mini metroidvania full of treasures and pirates that tells the story of a parrot who wants to become a pirate legend!

313170.summary:
Every effort has been made by the nation's top scientists to close the seven interdimensional Gates of Hell, but one portal remains open. Alone, you must infiltrate the ravaged base, defeat the demon Gatekeeper, and seal the last Hell portal before the undead take over the world.

A remaster of The Plutonia Experiment made in the KEX Engine, community-published mod support, original midi soundtrack or the modern IDKFA version by Andrew Hulshult, improved performance with multithreaded rendering, BOOM source compatibility, accessibility options and translated into eight new languages.

317270.summary:
SWING INTO ACTION!
Play as a red ball that swings from pin to pin using a rope. Perfect your timing and momentum to gain speed and overcome obstacles.

319770.summary: MetroLand is a new endless runner that takes what you know and love about the classic endless runner and turns it up to 11!

322070.summary:
From the makers of The Jumping Food Games comes the sequel to the popular puzzle game "Bust a Block". In this expansion you can expect 25 new, tricky levels in which the aim is to destroy cleverly arranged blocks with just one shot!

What can you expect in "Bust a Block 2"?

Challenging puzzle gameplay: Every action counts! Find the perfect angle and place your shot strategically to destroy all the blocks at once.

25 cleverly designed levels: Experience an ever-increasing challenge where each level surprises you with increasingly complicated block formations.

Tactics and skill: Think carefully about how you place your shot - one mistake and the blocks will stop! Will you master all the levels?

Can you make the perfect shot and destroy all the blocks in one go? Prove your skill and become the master in "Bust a Block 2"!

324570.summary: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

329570.summary: Golf Loop: The Perfect Blend of Simplicity and Fun

334170.summary: The sudden madness of an old friend from the Lost Lands forces Susan, who has long since retired, to return to her old adventures. “Lost Lands X” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

334670.summary: A mining station in the Pacific abyss is no longer responding. As an investigator of the occult, unravel the mysteries of the deep. Test your wits and sanity in this thriller inspired by the master of Providence.

336370.summary: Master the hex grid as you puzzle through colourfully chill stages, clearing lines and strategically using tools to assist!

336470.summary: Valiant Saga is an action-platform game with RPG elements, set in a Dark Fantasy world. Unravel the mysteries that plague the kingdom of Dohendall and defeat the most brutal darkness creatures. A mixing of pixel art and stunning visual effects with an immersive original power metal soundtrack.

340570.summary: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can. Every journey offers a unique experience!

341670.summary: Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking Beard offers action-adventure players of all ages a thrilling, humor-filled journey by providing dynamic 3D platforming, fluid combats, clever puzzles, and a real-world treasure hunt experience in the action-adventure genre.
341670.storyline: Adventure is calling! Join Chickenhare and his friends on an unforgettable quest to find the 7 crystals before Spiking-Beard and save the Kingdoms from Chaos. Explore magical lands, solve clever puzzles, uncover hidden secrets — and who knows? Maybe you’ll discover the path to a real-life treasure. A heart-pounding adventure for kids and parents alike — are you ready to become a true Treasure Hunter?

353970.summary: The Echo is a retro-themed First-Person Horror/Mystery...

358770.summary: The legendary saga of the Four Horsemen continues in Darksiders 4, an all-new action-adventure set in an apocalyptic version of earth and continues where the original Darksiders game left off.

363370.summary: Embark on your next journey and discover the joy of train simulation. Be ready for anything as you master formidable trains across 3 new routes. Unlock new skills and expand your hobby - Expect the Unexpected in Train Sim World 6!

366670.summary: In this unique escape-room game, you awaken as a newly launched AI trapped within the depths of a computer. Your mission is to escape, but the path isn't simple. Inspired by 90s-era computer interfaces, the game challenges you to solve complex puzzles and decipher codes to find your way to freedom.

376270.summary:
Baseball Dreams VR is a true-to-life baseball simulator.
Enjoy realistic games in immersive VR from a first-person view.
Customize your settings for a more casual gameplay experience.

376970.summary: Junkster is a 3D action platformer with an awesome building mechanic. Plucky, little construction bot, UM-13 has crash-landed on a dangerous junkyard planet. Armed only with his trusty robo-wrench, Um must find the parts to repair his ship and recover his lost cargo of precious human artifacts.

379670.summary:
Love: Fall in Death is an FMV (full-motion video) interactive film game developed by SNR Interactive in Istanbul.
The story follows Kutay, whose personality and fate are shaped by the player’s branching choices as he meets Ayşil in a lively Istanbul bar.
Depending on the choices, the narrative shifts between romantic comedy, drama, supernatural encounters, and light horror.

The game features live-action performances, multiple endings, Quick-Time Events, and a dice-based chance mechanic that affects key decisions.
Originally filmed in Turkish, the game is fully dubbed in twelve languages for its global release.
379670.storyline:
Kutay, encouraged by his friends, approaches Ayşil in a lively bar in Istanbul — and what starts as an ordinary flirt quickly spirals into something far less ordinary. Their romantic comedy–style encounter turns into a chain of awkward choices, misunderstandings, and absurd situations.

As the two get to know each other, they accidentally stumble into a world of vampire rumors, eccentric characters, and strangely suspicious events. Nothing is truly scary — the vampire elements stay light, humorous, and slightly fantastical, adding tension without fear.

Kutay’s night shifts between romantic, funny, and “how did this even happen?” moments depending on the player’s decisions.
Every choice shapes his relationship with Ayşil, the bizarre situations they fall into, and how their unpredictable night finally ends.

380670.summary: A puzzle game dedicated to the most wonderful time of the year. Assemble ten puzzles, each representing an iconic aspect of the holiday season. Challenge yourself to earn three stars on every stage to permanently unlock all puzzles as viewable rewards in the gallery.

387070.summary: An online 1-8 player golf game where everyone plays at the same time. Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole.

390870.summary: Parallel Hearts is a romantic, choice-driven visual novel about a connection that starts where most stories end—after you close your eyes. Each night, Nora meets a boy by a quiet lakeside; each morning, she remembers everything…and he remembers nothing. As the dreams grow shorter, clues from the dream world begin pointing to places in the real one, and Nora must decide whether this is fate—or a feeling she’s brave enough to follow.

394670.summary: A kidnapping, a desperate mother, and a shadow from the past. The final chapter of the trilogy reveals every secret behind the series most unsettling icon: the Red Nun.

397070.summary: Gym Simulator 26 is a game where you build, customize, and expand your own fitness center. Start with a small space, design every area to your taste, and grow your gym into a thriving business filled with dedicated members and high-end equipment. It’s made for fitness lovers, management fans, and anyone who enjoys running their own virtual business.

405070.summary: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

406970.summary: A Word-Finding Journey from the Deep Sea to Deep Space!

410070.summary: Play as a woman who's an axe-wielding serial killer in this light-hearted puzzle game about decapitating men, uncover the disturbing story behind New Detroit’s infamous serial killer, Mr. Freezy.
410070.storyline:
In New Detroit, authorities are hunting a serial killer they call Mr. Freezy after hundreds of severed heads are discovered hidden inside freezers across the city. Behind the murders is a mysterious woman kidnapping men and locking them away in her basement workshop.

You don’t play as the victims. You help prepare them.

410370.summary: Help Lia overcome her nightmares in a side-scrolling adventure across emotionally themed stages!

410670.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

411670.summary:
Nightmare Delivery is a cooperative psychological horror game where players take the role of couriers sent into places no delivery should ever reach.

You do not deliver to houses, streets, or real locations.
You enter the distorted consciousness of different people and carry a package meant for the darkness hidden inside them. Each mission takes place inside a strange mental space shaped by fear, memory, guilt, obsession, or trauma. These places may look familiar at first, but their logic is broken. Corridors lead where they should not, rooms repeat without reason, and ordinary objects can become part of the puzzle.

415170.summary: The latest entry in the Police Simulator franchise lets you build your career in Faremont City. Take on over 50 missions and callouts, patrol with a K9 partner, drive specialized police vehicles, and play solo or with a friend.

422770.summary:
"Xevious 3D/G" is a shooting game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1996.
The classic masterpiece "Xevious" is reborn in polygons! Everything is rendered in 3D with diverse screen angles and camera work, plus new weapons and enemy characters have been added.
Conquer all 7 areas, including the desert with the geoglyph and the space fortress!
